opening.text: I've been sweating a lot more than usual. I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe, and I have bouts of choking or shortness of breath that wake me up at night. Since this started I've had new tiredness, a vague general discomfort, aching muscles or a change in how well I feel overall. I have high blood pressure or take medicine for it, and I've had a heart attack or I have angina. I have heart failure.
